title: Viva Glint: import HRIS data through Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap details, licensing requirement and administrative controls are supported by Microsoft's documentation. Minor corrections should complete the CSV wizard routes and distinguish the CSV guide's explicit employee-deactivation warning from the Glint overview's conditional wording.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service centrally imports employee data for Microsoft 365 and Viva apps, including Viva Glint.

claims.quote: You don't have to distribute organizational data to supported apps using Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service, but doing so enhances their functionality.

claims.quote: Licensing requirements vary based on the Microsoft 365 or Viva app that will consume organizational data from Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service.

claims.claim: The Glint switch is at Configuration > Service Configuration > General Settings > Technical configuration > Organizational data imports.
claims.quote: Select the Configuration symbol on your Viva Glint admin dashboard and then General Settings in the Service Configuration section. Technical Configuration: Organizational data imports.

claims.claim: Learn documents no API for the Viva Glint Organizational data imports switch.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Organizational data imports enable disable API Graph PowerShell ORG_UPLOAD_SWITCHED_OFF. Read manage-general-settings, modis-data-consumption and import API call; no operation setting the Glint switch found.

claims.claim: Completing onboarding automatically sets Organizational data imports to Yes.
claims.quote: After the onboarding process is completed, Viva Glint is configured to import employee data from Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service. The Organizational data imports setting is automatically set to Yes.

claims.claim: Disabling imports stops Glint ingestion and uploads return ORG_UPLOAD_SWITCHED_OFF.
claims.quote: When imports are disabled, Viva Glint stops importing employee data from Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service, and uploads return the ORG_UPLOAD_SWITCHED_OFF advisory.

claims.claim: Viva Glint is not an available destination when Organizational data imports is disabled.
claims.quote: If Viva Glint doesn’t appear as a option in the Choose apps and services page, it means that the Organizational Data imports feature is disabled in Viva Glint.

claims.claim: Tenant role assignment is at Microsoft Entra admin center > Identity > Roles & admins > role > Add assignments.
claims.quote: Browse to Identity > Roles & admins. Select a role name to open the role. Select Add assignments and then select the users, groups, or agent identities you want to assign to this role.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments assigns the directory role.

claims.claim: The tenant-scoped portal assignment steps require at least Privileged Role Administrator.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center as at least a Privileged Role Administrator.

claims.quote: The Organizational Data Source Administrator role is assigned by a Global Administrator.

claims.claim: Viva Glint service administrators can also be assigned Organizational Data Source Administrator.
claims.quote: Viva Glint service administrators can also be assigned this role when they need to configure employee data imports through Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service.

claims.claim: Existing Glint customers with employee data must complete one-time attribute-mapping onboarding before imports can flow.
claims.quote: Existing customers with employee data already configured in Viva Glint must complete a one-time onboarding process to map Organizational data attributes to Viva Glint attributes before Viva Glint can import employee data from Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service.

claims.claim: The integration is released in phases, and an absent onboarding banner means it is not yet available in that tenant.
claims.quote: Organizational data in Microsoft 365 is being released in phases. If you don't see the onboarding banner, the feature isn't available yet in your tenant.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Employees missing from a full import may become inactive in Viva Glint depending on configuration.
claims.quote: Employees that previously existed in Viva Glint but aren't included in a full import may become inactive, depending on your configuration and import behavior.
claims.fix: Keep the conditional overview statement and add: 'The CSV service guide is more explicit: selecting Update the entire Viva Glint dataset marks users absent from that file Inactive, including active users supplied by other connectors.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/org-data-service/import/import-orgdata.

claims.claim: Every Workday refresh is a full import.
claims.quote: Workday: Every refresh is a full import and sends a full-import signal to Viva Glint.

claims.claim: A Workday connector schema change automatically triggers a full import.
claims.quote: Any schema change for the Workday or SAP SuccessFactors connector automatically triggers a full import.

claims.claim: A SAP SuccessFactors connector schema change automatically triggers a full import.
claims.quote: Any schema change for the Workday or SAP SuccessFactors connector automatically triggers a full import.

claims.claim: After a schema change on other connector types, administrators must send data for all employees again.
claims.quote: For all other connector types, after a schema update, administrators must manually send data for all employees through a new incremental or full import.

claims.claim: Multiple connectors disable automatic full imports to Glint through Workday and SAP SuccessFactors.
claims.quote: If your organization has multiple instances of the same connector, or multiple different connectors, automatic full imports to Viva Glint through the Workday and SAP SuccessFactors connectors are turned off.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope: Limits
claims.claim: Each connector sends data to only one Viva Glint instance.
claims.quote: If your tenant has multiple Viva Glint instances, each connector can send data to only one Viva Glint instance.

claims.claim: Multiple connectors can feed Viva Glint.
claims.quote: You can set up multiple connectors to import data into Viva Glint.

claims.claim: A Glint manager hierarchy derived from an attribute mapped to Microsoft_ManagerEmail mirrors Profile's hierarchy.
claims.quote: If the Viva Glint manager hierarchy is derived from a Viva Glint attribute that's mapped to Microsoft_ManagerEmail, the Viva Glint manager hierarchy mirrors the Profile hierarchy.

claims.claim: The consumption page instead names Microsoft_ManagerID in its advice about keeping hierarchies distinct.
claims.quote: If you want to keep the Viva Glint Manager Hierarchy distinct from the Profile or Entra Manager Hierarchy then don’t map Microsoft_ManagerID to Viva Glint’s attribute used for Manager hierarchy derivation.

claims.claim: The Glint schema requires Email Address, First Name, Last Name, Status and Employee ID.
claims.quote: including the five required attributes: Email Address, First Name, Last Name, Status, and Employee ID.

claims.claim: Custom attributes import only when a corresponding Glint attribute already exists with an exact case-sensitive name match.
claims.quote: Viva Glint imports custom Organizational data attributes only when a corresponding Viva Glint attribute already exists and the attribute names match exactly, including letter casing.

claims.claim: Unmatched custom attributes are ignored.
claims.quote: If Viva Glint receives a custom Organizational data attribute that doesn't match an existing Viva Glint attribute, the attribute is ignored and an advisory message is included in the error messages provided after the upload completes.

claims.claim: Data connections displays connection validation and import status.
claims.quote: The Data connections page displays the files processed through the selected connection and the status of each validation and import operation.

claims.claim: The connection validation view includes an ingestion summary and advisory details.
claims.quote: Each data import is assigned a unique ingestion ID, and the validation page provides an ingestion summary and advisory details.
